The Sector That Never Stopped Growing While much of the Canadian labour market spent 2025 in a state of cautious equilibrium, one sector continued to expand without pause. Healthcare and social assistance added 21,000 positions in December 2025 alone and grew by more than 85,000 jobs over the previous twelve months, according to Statistics Canada’s Labour Force Survey.
